name: Blind World Hub Screen Recorder
summary: An accessible screen recorder for blind and visually impaired people, now with background music that gets softer by itself whenever you or your screen reader speaks.
whatsNew: What's new in version 1.1: background music Add background music to your recordings. Choose any song or music file from your phone, and it plays softly under your recording. Music volume: set how loud the music is, from silent to louder than normal. Music softer and Music louder: change the music's volume while you are recording. The music gets softer when someone speaks: when you or your screen reader speaks, the music goes down by itself and comes back up in the pauses, like on FM radio. Choose a ready-made style: FM radio: goes down at once and comes back up in half a second (recommended) YouTube tutorial: goes down a little deeper and comes back up in about one and a half seconds Soft and relaxed: goes down deep and comes back up slowly Like GoldWave: waits for a real pause of 3 seconds before coming back up Silent while someone speaks My own settings: choose how much softer, how fast it goes down, how long it waits and how fast it comes back up Off: the music never gets softer Voice sensitivity: decides how loud the speaking must be before the music goes down. High works for soft voices in a quiet room, Medium suits most people, and Low suits noisy places, so fans and traffic do not lower the music. A louder voice lowers the music a little more: the louder you speak, the softer the music goes, so it sounds natural. Clear space for the voice: only the part of the music where voices sit goes down, so the music stays full and your voice stays clear. Every song at about the same loudness: loud songs and quiet songs are brought to a similar volume, so every video sounds even. Music comes in and goes out softly: the music rises gently over 2 seconds at the start and fades out at the end, instead of starting or stopping suddenly. Background music in Make video: add music to a recording you already made, with the same options.
